recording.lineage: Set 1 Recording Info: Nakamichi 300 Mics ->Maxell XLII 90, set up in back of the floor. Transfer Info: Maxell XLII 90->Tascam BX1 (modified for flat transfer)->Tascam MKII-DR07 (24/bit, 96kHz) Editing: All editing (NAB curve applied, fade in, 2 fades out cut into tracks) with DC8Forensics. Slight correction for distance from speakers. Recorded by Bill Doherty
